scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names contracts,chess,database,api,web "tsc -b packages/contracts --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -b packages/chess --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -b packages/database --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch --conditions=development --import tsx apps/api/src/server.ts" "vite apps/web --host localhost --port 5173"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @neurochess/api && npm run build --workspace @neurochess/web
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web "npm run start --workspace @neurochess/api" "npm run preview --workspace @neurochess/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:architecture
scripts.test:architecture: depcruise --config dependency-cruiser.config.mjs apps packages && node scripts/check-architecture-fixture.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
